copy.tagline_en: Automate extracting and updating leads from Aeroleads

howto.what: 装上后，当你说出与Aeroleads相关的任务时，Claude会通过Rube MCP自动搜索可用工具、检查连接，然后执行具体操作（如查找潜在客户、管理联系人）。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude执行Aeroleads上的操作（如查找客户、更新联系人）时，遇到需要调用Aeroleads工具的场景自动触发。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude can automate Aeroleads tasks via Rube MCP: it will first search for available tools, check the connection status, then execute specific operations (e.g., finding leads, managing contacts).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform Aeroleads-related tasks (e.g., find leads, update contacts), automatically invoking the Aeroleads toolkit through Rube MCP.
